text: The greatest thing you'll ever learn is just to love and be loved in return.
author: Eden Ahbez

text: You don't love someone for their looks, or their clothes, or for their fancy car, but because they sing a song only you can hear.
author: Oscar Wilde

text: The meeting of two personalities is like the contact of two chemical substances: if there is any reaction, both are transformed.
author: Carl Jung

text: Love is not about how many days, months, or years you've been together. It's about how much you love each other every single day.
author: Unknown

text: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
author: Audrey Hepburn

text: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
author: Lao Tzu

text: No relationship is all sunshine, but two people can share one umbrella and survive the storm together.
author: Unknown

text: If you're a lover, you gotta be a fighter, 'cause if you don't fight for your love, what kind of love do you have?
author: Keanu Reeves

text: A man bought 20 flowers: 19 real and 1 fake. He said: 'I will love you until the last flower dies'.
author: Unknown

text: Physics isn't the most important thing. Love is.
author: Richard P. Feynman

text: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
author: Lao Tzu

text: Love is that condition in which the happiness of another person is essential to your own.
author: Robert A. Heinlein

text: When a man learns to love, he must bear the risk of hatred.
author: Uchiha Madara

text: There's only one thing that can heal the heart... Only one... It's love, Gaara.
author: Yashamaru

text: I miss your voice because it is a symphony; your scent because it is a treasure; your smile because it is a jewel; your hug because it is a masterpiece; and your kiss because it is a miracle.
author: Matshona Dhliwayo

text: An angel who makes you cry is better than a devil who makes you smile.
author: Matshona Dhliwayo

text: I had my hand over her heart to keep it beating. It was the happiest noise I had ever heard.
author: Kousei Arima

text: You made me hear music again. And I didn't even know I had gone deaf.
author: Kousei Arima

text: Even if I can't stay with you forever, I will leave my mark on your heart. That's what it means to love someone.
author: Kaori Miyazono

text: The more you get to know someone, the more you realize that love isn't something you find. It's something you build, one day at a time.
author: Tomoya Okazaki

text: I never thought the person I'd fall in love with would be the one who smiled at me like that on an ordinary afternoon.
author: Nagisa Furukawa

text: Love doesn't always come with fireworks. Sometimes it comes quietly, in the spaces between two people who finally stop running from each other.
author: Ryuuji Takasu

text: The best kind of love is the kind that catches you off guard — the kind where you didn't even know you were falling until you'd already landed.
author: Taiga Aisaka

text: If I write a letter and it never reaches you, I hope you know: every sentence was true.
author: Violet Evergarden

text: To love and to be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
author: Okabe Rintaro

text: I would rewrite time itself if it meant keeping you safe. That's not obsession — that's what love does.
author: Okabe Rintaro

text: Mayuri taught me that love isn't about holding on. It's about being willing to let someone into the parts of you that are still broken.
author: Okabe Rintaro

text: I would gladly endure every painful loop if it meant I could hold you one more time.
author: Subaru Natsuki

text: You are worth every fight, every tear, every impossible second. I'd choose you again and again.
author: Edward Elric

text: Winry taught me that love isn't something you find in grand gestures. It lives in the small, quiet ways someone stays.
author: Edward Elric

text: Love is the one thing I never planned to feel. And now I can't imagine my world without it.
author: Lelouch vi Britannia

text: In another life, in a world that made sense, I would have chosen you without hesitation.
author: Kallen Stadtfeld

text: When you find the right person, the whole world seems to slow down just so you can notice them.
author: Howl

text: The best love stories aren't the ones where everything is perfect. They're the ones where two imperfect people choose each other anyway.
author: Naruto Uzumaki

text: Kakashi once told me that the people who matter most are the ones you'd risk everything for. I finally understand what he meant.
author: Naruto Uzumaki

text: You don't love the way you thought you would. You love the way you never expected — quietly, completely, without apology.
author: Eren Yeager

text: The notebook was filled with letters I wrote to you. Every page was a day I missed you. Every word was proof that absence doesn't erase love.
author: Noah Calhoun

text: The best thing I ever did was say yes to you, even when everything in me said it was too soon.
author: Allie Hamilton

text: It is a truth universally acknowledged that a single person in possession of a good heart must be in want of love.
author: Elizabeth Bennet

text: You have bewitched me, body and soul, and I love you. I love you.
author: Mr. Darcy

text: I'm always going to want more time with you. That's how I know it's real.
author: Sebastian Wilder

text: The city taught us to dream, and we found each other in the middle of it. That wasn't an accident.
author: Mia Dolan

text: How happy I am to have loved you, even if it cost me the earth.
author: Joel Barish
source: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004)

text: Meet me in Montauk.
author: Clementine Kruczynski
source: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004)

text: I'm drowning here, and you're learning to swim.
author: Jack Dawson

text: You jump, I jump. That's not a promise. That's a fact.
author: Jack Dawson

text: Love isn't about grand gestures or expensive dinners. It's about knowing someone well enough to make them laugh when they're about to cry.
author: Eleanor Young

text: You don't get to choose if you get hurt in this world. But you do get to choose who hurts you.
author: Augustus Waters

text: Loving you was the easiest part of my entire life.
author: Hazel Grace Lancaster

text: The best love story ever told is the one where two people choose each other in front of a typewriter and a bottle of wine.
author: Viola de Lesseps

text: I don't want to be someplace else. I want to be right here, with you, for as long as right here lasts.
author: Harry Burns

text: When you realize you want to spend the rest of your life with somebody, you want the rest of your life to start as soon as possible.
author: Harry Burns

text: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you — unless it's an untold love.
author: Jane Eyre

text: As you wish.
author: Westley

text: Death cannot stop true love. All it can do is delay it for a while.
author: Westley

text: Le monde entier appartient à celui qui sait bien aimer — the whole world belongs to those who know how to love.
author: Amélie Poulain

text: The real trick to life is not to be dead when it ends.
author: Tim Lake

text: All the happiness in the world starts and ends with another person. It's time I started looking.
author: Tim Lake

text: Love is the kind of thing that makes you want to be a better man.
author: Kevin Bacon

text: I love you without knowing from when, without looking toward a future or an infinite past. I love you as certain dark things are to be loved, in secret, between the shadow and the soul.
author: Pablo Neruda

text: Tonight I love you, tomorrow I will too. The day after that is forever, and that's how I plan to spend it.
author: Pablo Neruda

text: The soul has been given ears to hear things the mind does not understand.
author: Rumi

text: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing, there is a field. I'll meet you there.
author: Rumi

text: Tell me whom you love, and I will tell you who you are.
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

text: It is a truth almost universally acknowledged that love, once begun, tends to continue.
author: Jane Austen

text: There is no greater happiness than to be convinced that one is loved.
author: Charlotte Bronte

text: The best love is the love that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more, that plants a fire in our bellies and brings peace to our minds.
author: Nicholas Sparks

text: If you find someone who makes you happy, that's rare. Hold on tight. The world will try to take it from you.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways. I love thee to the depth and breadth and height my soul can reach.
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

text: The thing about love is, it doesn't follow rules. It doesn't care about timing. It just shows up.
author: Ryan Reynolds

text: Love is choosing the same person every single morning, even on the hard days. Especially on the hard days.
author: Blake Lively

text: All I ever wanted was to find someone who loves me the way I love music — completely and without condition.
author: John Legend

text: Someone out there is meant to love the exact version of you that you are right now.
author: Adele

text: Love is not a whisper. It's a decision you make loudly, every day, in front of everyone.
author: Taylor Swift

text: You know you've found the right person when their laugh makes you forget everything you were worried about.
author: Cary Grant

text: Love is a two-way street commonly traveled by two-way traffic.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: The heart has its reasons which reason knows nothing of.
author: Blaise Pascal

text: To be loved but lost; or to be loved and found — that is the question every heart eventually asks.
author: Pablo Neruda

text: Love is not something you find. It is something you grow into, slowly and then all at once.
author: Nicholas Sparks

text: You don't fall in love with someone's perfection. You fall in love with the way they make your imperfections feel okay.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: I have seen the best of you, and waited for the rest of you. I will keep waiting.
author: Jane Austen

text: In all the world, there is no heart for me like yours. In all the world, there is no love for you like mine.
author: Maya Angelou

text: The moment I saw you, I knew my life would never be the same. Every story I'd ever read was just practice for this one.
author: Elizabeth Bennet

text: Trust is built in small moments. A hand held. A promise kept. A name whispered in the dark.
author: Brene Brown

text: You know you're in love when you can't sleep because reality is finally better than your dreams.
author: Dr. Seuss

text: The greatest risk, for men or for women, is to remain in loveless comfort.
author: Deepak Chopra

text: Two people are in love when they make each other feel like they are not alone.
author: Marian Keyes

text: I have waited for you so long, I am no longer afraid of it. I am only afraid of what I become without you.
author: Charlotte Bronte

text: Real love does not treat you like a project. It holds you like a treasure.
author: Iyanla Vanzant

text: We loved with a love that was more than love.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

text: Romance is not about closing your eyes and hoping. It's about opening them wide and choosing to stay.
author: Ryan Reynolds

text: You make ordinary moments extraordinary. That is the most powerful kind of love there is.
author: Blake Lively

text: Love is a place and a state of mind. It begins with yourself — and then it reaches outward to encompass someone else.
author: Deepak Chopra

text: The first time you truly love someone, you learn what it means to let go of every version of yourself you used to be.
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

text: Connection is the energy that exists between people when they feel seen, heard, and valued.
author: Brene Brown

text: Love is when you meet someone who tells you, 'Hey, you're kind of messed up,' and then proceeds to love you anyway.
author: John Green

text: Falling in love is not a choice. To stay in love is.
author: Zayed Khan

text: Every love story is a ghost story.
author: David Foster Wallace

text: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin to love.
author: Walt Disney

text: I didn't fall in love with you. I walked into love with you, with my eyes open, because I wanted to.
author: Craig Ferguson
